text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed by the park, 
Marvelous Sunday was surrounded by elderly 
folks.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
Look, Marvelous-chan! There was a little 
octopus in the dried baby sardines!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"This morning, I saw a mother cat and her 
kittens walking along a wall. I couldn't 
help snapping a photo~♪"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Everyone is so marvelous☆ So much 
sparkle and shine! MARVELOUS★☆★
choice_data_list: What kind of gathering is this?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! It's a gathering to show off 
our Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We're showing each other all the Marvelous 
things we found~☆

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"We all owe so much to Marvelous-chan. She 
often comes over to our place to hang out 
and everything, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. When you live alone, the 
time spent with Marvelous-chan is just so 
delightful.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Meeting Marvelous-chan made me realize. 
You can find marvels in absolutely 
anything! Ever since then, everything I 
see has looked so fresh and new.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The world is full of marvelous☆ Let's keep 
finding more and more marvelous things 
together★

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
You bet! By the way, Marvelous-chan, want 
some dango? As thanks for always being 
there!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I made some ohagi too. There's plenty, so 
please eat as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Waaah! So manyâ Marveloouuusâ ââ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sweets given to her as a token of 
gratitude. It was far too much for 
Marvelous Sunday to eat alone.
choice_data_list: That's way too much for one person to eat.
I should gratefully accept all of it.
We should gratefully accept all of it.

text_block_list.text:
The sweets given to her as a token of 
gratitude. It was far too much for 
Marvelous Sunday to eat alone.
choice_data_list: That's way too much for one person to eat.
I should gratefully accept all of it.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If you say so, Trainer, then I guess it 
really is overeating...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh. Looks like eating all of it would 
be way too much.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nope! The gratitude you gave me along with 
the sweets is simply marvelousâ

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Sharing makes it so much more Marvelous☆ 
So let's all eat together! ★☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The gathering turned into a tea party with 
the elderly. Thanks to sharing them, 
Marvelous Sunday ended up eating just a 
reasonable amount.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna happily eat every single 
bit~~!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. There's tea too, so please help 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday finished eating every 
last bit of the massive pile of sweets she 
received.
